decisions.reason: The sister fouling-detection system C was withdrawn and A was not visibly promoted in 2024, which raises the risk, but the automation logic fits the firm's control software and energy-recovery direction, and its own R&D lets it fold what it learned into its broader automation offer.
The weir-dimensioning web tool rests on the firm's long hydraulic engineering record and existing IT modules, costs little to maintain, and supports sales of its weir products such as D and F.
The spring-controlled flap weir is close to the firm's core flood-control hardware, so the firm can readily interpret field results and refine it.

The energy management system builds on the firm's automation software and matches its strategic push toward networked, energy-efficient water infrastructure, where its R&D and university ties give it strong learning capacity.
The overflow flap gate line has its own web page, several models, and a close fit with the established water-level regulation business, which signals commitment and low risk.
